newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus trade deficit for Jan-May falls 3.3pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus trade deficit for Jan-May falls 3.3pct.

text.p: Cyprus's trade defecit fell 3.3 percent to 514.4 million pounds ($933.5 million)in the first five months compared to 532.3 million a year ago, the statistics department said Thursday.
Total imports for the five-month period declined 4.5 percent to 765.1 million pounds, compared to 801.3 million for the same period last year.
Total exports in the first five months dropped 6.8 percent to 250.7 million, compared to 269 million over the same period in 1996.
